description: Hardware is not maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated firmware versions, end-of-life hardware still in production, lack of hardware lifecycle management, failure to sanitize hardware before disposal, missing hardware maintenance schedules, and inadequate tracking of hardware assets.
